name: Ubuntu Webtop Desktop
postStartCommand: for i in $(seq 1 120); do docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep 1; done; docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'Docker daemon did not become available'; exit 1; }; docker start webtop 2>/dev/null || docker run -d --name=webtop --security-opt seccomp=unconfined --shm-size="2gb" -p 3000:3000 -e PUID=1000 -e PGID=1000 -e TZ=Australia/Brisbane -v /workspaces/${localWorkspaceFolderBasename}/webtop-config:/config -v /workspaces/${localWorkspaceFolderBasename}/webtop-setup:/webtop-setup:ro --restart unless-stopped lscr.io/linuxserver/webtop:ubuntu-xfce; for i in $(seq 1 60); do docker exec webtop true 2>/dev/null && break; sleep 1; done; docker exec -u root webtop /webtop-setup/install-google-chrome.sh
